events.text: {"verdict":"proceed","decision":"Close the triage gap; do not lower the 90% target. 1) Write a labelling rubric in workshop-plan/feedback-intake: bug vs feature, severity levels copied from docs/bug-pipeline/severity.md, and a duplicate rule. 2) Relabel the existing 30 reports by that rubric and keep them as the tuning set. 3) Collect a fresh held-out set of 30 real reports (session transcripts, the T-152 audit bugs behind PRs 160 to 164, T-153 seed requests, team notes) and label them by the rubric before running the agent. 4) Improve the agent: put the severity rubric in the prompt and use T-153's reqstore BM25 match for duplicates. 5) Score on the held-out set; pass is 27/30 or better. Log both scores and every miss honestly; iterate on the tuning set only. 6) Commit and push, then re-request Bharath's review on PR 166. Do not merge.
